data.desc: AmpliTech Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMPG, AMPGZ) designs, develops and manufactures advanced RF and microwave signal-processing components and next-generation 5G infrastructure systems. Its portfolio includes low-noise amplifiers, cryogenic amplifiers, Massive MIMO O-RAN radio systems and 5G Network-in-a-Box solutions for defense, satellite communications, quantum computing and telecommunications. Products are designed and engineered in the United States.
